notes: Vec<bool> stores one byte per flag (unlike C++'s std::vector<bool>, it is never bit-packed).
Multiples are crossed off with (p * p..=n).step_by(p); the outer bound is usize::isqrt(n).
Digits are checked explicitly because str::parse::<usize> also accepts a leading '+'.
Release profile: opt-level 3, fat LTO, 1 codegen unit; static musl binary on a scratch image.
